Hacker Used Claude AI to Score Free Tickets to Nearly Every US Music Show

A critical unauthenticated SQL injection vulnerability in Front Gate Tickets (FGT), a Live Nation/Ticketmaster subsidiary that powers ticketing for major US festivals including EDC, Bonnaroo, and Outside Lands, allowed full administrative takeover of the platform with help from Anthropic’s Claude AI
